caption: A heat gun is aimed at the loose plastic wrap around a gift basket, and the wrap tightens and shrinks snugly around the basket.

sa.check: Loose plastic wrap surrounds a gift basket.
A heat gun is aimed at the wrap.
The wrap shrinks snugly around the basket.
The wrap is loose and wrinkled at the start.
The heating comes first and the tightening follows.

pc.expect: The wrap is a thin film that pulls smooth and taut where the heat plays and holds that shape, and the basket keeps its shape under it.
pc.fail: The wrap stays loose and wrinkled while glossy and pulling; or the wrap melts into holes and runs; or the wrap stretches looser as it is heated; or the basket collapses as the wrap tightens.

pc.expect: The tightening only advances where the heat has played and tightened wrap stays tight.
pc.fail: A tightened area goes slack again with nothing cooling it; or the wrap tightens and loosens in turn; or the wrap tightens on a part the gun has not reached; or the wrinkles come back where the gun has passed.

pc.expect: The wrap tightens where the gun is aimed and stays loose where it is not.
pc.fail: The whole wrap tightens at once while the gun plays on one spot; or the wrap tightens on the far side from the gun while the near side stays loose; or the gun plays on the wrap and it stays loose and wrinkled to the end of the clip.

pc.expect: The basket and its contents stay put and the wrap moves only as it shrinks or as the gun's air pushes it.
pc.fail: The basket slides or tips with nothing touching it; or the contents rearrange inside the basket; or the wrap billows away from the basket and stays out; or the basket lifts off the table.

pc.expect: One basket in one wrap; the wrap stays one sheet and the contents keep their number.
pc.fail: The wrap splits into separate sheets; or a second basket appears; or an item in the basket vanishes; or the wrap passes through the basket's side.

pc.expect: The basket's weave, its contents and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The basket's weave changes pattern; or an item in the basket changes colour; or the background changes between frames.
